episodes.title: Symptome
episodes.summary: Zanna faces a challenging first day running the emergency room at a frantic, overcrowded Berlin hospital.

episodes.title: Ermittlungen
episodes.summary: Under pressure from the medical director, Zanna is forced to hunt for a scapegoat. Ben insists on his own methods to treat a pregnant patient.

episodes.title: Diagnose
episodes.summary: Zanna clashes with the staff after introducing new department rules. Ben's struggles become more evident.

episodes.title: Behandlung
episodes.summary: Ben and Zanna finally begin to make peace. Emina, Dom, Olivia, and Olaf find themselves fighting through a busy night shift.

episodes.title: Nebenwirkungen
episodes.summary: Ben's battle with addiction becomes more dangerous. Emina's family life intrudes at work. Zanna's flawed decision has dire consequences.

episodes.title: Selbstmedikation
episodes.summary: Zanna and Emina consider how to move forward. Ben grapples with post-traumatic stress disorder. Dom makes a life-changing mistake.

episodes.title: Endstadium
episodes.summary: Zanna and Ben finally have to address his health—and their feelings. Olivia and Olaf strain as they work together. Dom deals with terrible guilt.

episodes.title: Remission
episodes.summary: Season finale. A huge fire puts doctors and nurses to the ultimate test. Zanna and Ben confront difficult decisions about their futures.
